title.en: An Act Revising the Form of Taxation on Petroleum Products from Ad Valorem to Specific, Amending for the Purpose Section 145 of the National Internal Revenue Code as Amended by Republic Act Numbered Sixty-Seven Hundred Sixty-Seven

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1990/ra_6965_1990.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: All laws, decrees, executive orders, issuances, rules and regulations, or any part thereof, which are inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
